spanish: Que príncipe pecare, e hiciere una desde todos mandamientos de Jehová su Dios que no se harán, por error, y culpado:

findings.issue: Qal sequential perfect 3ms (‘and he is/becomes guilty’) is a bare passive participle, so person and qal verbal force drop and the guilt is not clearly the prince’s act.
Partitive מִן (‘one from/of all’) is desde, which reads as a starting point rather than one out of the whole.

notes: Remaining tokens match: prince, qal 3ms sin and do, one, commandments of Jehová his God, relative negative niphal 3fp, in error.
